Occurrences.Kwic: 問僧：一大藏教是惡口，如何是本身盧舍那？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Complete Five Lamps (Vols. 34–120) (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), section on Xiatang Huiyuan: Xiatang asks a monk what original-body Lushena is; “the monk said” (僧曰) begins the monk's answer.

Senses.Explanation: Lushena Buddha is named directly and in questions about “original-body Lushena.” Baizhang's continuous three-body discourse distinguishes the purity-body name Vairocana from the complete reward-body name Lushena Buddha; the stored reward-body passage also names equality wisdom and the seventh consciousness. Zhongfeng Mingben cites a statement that Lushena's own nature has no existent possession. The remaining cited interviews retain Lushena inside the question “What is original-body Lushena?”
